notes:
The sheet has an opening injectivity assertion and the beginning/continuation of its proof, using a semiabelian group G, the Kummer sequence, Galois cohomology and inverse limits. Twenty-one principal baseline text/display lines were read, counting the lower H^0(K,G) identification as its own displayed line and excluding separate interlinear additions and page numbers. The opening is Ces, distinguished from the straight L of the lower Le/La composé/composée line. Bold authorial 16 at top and a separate cancelled 16/46 below the opening sentence are both present. Thin 32 at lower left is separate foliation in another hand. The vertical two-stroke equality below G(K) is present, and the arrow in (16) leaves the G(K) row; the array preserves that arrangement. The bottom H^0(K) has no written second argument G: retain the omission. The two final inverse-limit signs have no written n under them. The final closing parenthesis at the right edge is partially clipped but its lower curved trace is visible and retained. The unheaded horizontal comparison stroke is not completed to an arrow; the mathematics describes a map but does not put a head in the ink. Both later inner H subscripts are n-like when joined to the H foot; 1 remains primary on the local notation but uncertainty is marked at both occurrences. Their overbars on G are dark, wavy/retraced strokes; retained as overbars following the locally established geometric G in (16), without asserting a new tilde notation. The cancelled composé remains doubtful; canonique is a live interlinear replacement. No additional letter is asserted from the tiny finishing flourish after the last hom. No script E occurs on this page. Two limited mathematical checks were carried out and recorded separately; the reduction to G and global injectivity are not checked or asserted proved here.

[Blind audit] The first and last connectors in each of the two short exact-sequence displays are bare horizontal strokes, unlike their headed interior arrows. Both witnesses supplied heads at these four endpoints. The subsequent inverse-limit display was additionally checked for this recurrence: its first connector has a distinct pointed head, so it is retained as an arrow. The stop after alg was supplied by both witnesses and is removed. The crossed number and Le/La composé/composée remain locally doubtful. The two later H indices keep 1 primary with n as an explicit alternative: the visible joined form alone is n-like, while the earlier separated H_1 and the written identity with the n-torsion limit support the same homology notation; no new calculation was undertaken. Hom has a terminal retracing flourish, not an extra lexical letter or a stop.

check_events.outcome: Verified conditionally on the displayed Kummer short exact sequence. The long exact cohomology sequence has H^0(G) --n--> H^0(G) --delta--> H^1({}_nG) --> H^1(G) --n--> H^1(G). Factoring the first map by its image and restricting the last map to its kernel yields exactly 0 --> H^0(K,G)/n --> H^1(K,{}_nG) --> H^1(K,G)[n] --> 0. This checks the displayed segment when its right/left subscript-n conventions mean cokernel/kernel. It does not check when the Kummer sequence is exact in an unspecified cohomology topology.

Verified the exactness claimed by the displayed inverse-limit sequence, assuming compatible transition maps between the preceding short exact sequences. Injectivity of lim A_n --> lim B_n holds coordinatewise. A compatible b_n in the kernel of lim B_n --> lim C_n has unique a_n lifts in A_n by finite-stage exactness and injectivity; uniqueness makes those lifts compatible. Thus the limit sequence is exact at lim A_n and lim B_n. No terminal surjectivity or Mittag-Leffler assertion is made, consistently with the absence of a final zero on the page.
